research_question: Which dataset names, metrics, assay properties and methods occur in a declared paper corpus and should inform downstream extraction schemas or specialization data?
inclusion_criteria: Include established technical expressions, datasets, metrics and assay properties when relevant to the declared domains.
Preserve acronym/full-form variants, units and domain-specific senses with table-block or page evidence.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude bibliographic author names and unrelated generic prose.
Do not treat a term occurrence as a complete experimental row, score record or automatic expert-model specialization.
